csv_project_name: AE for BRT Steam Vault Renewal
csv_agency: Ohio State University Facilities Planning & Dev
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio State University is seeking Architect/Engineer (A/E) to provide full engineering, design and construction management services. The initial design documents shall include initial site planning and project phasing options. These initial documents will develop performance requirements for vehicle and pedestrian circulation, the analysis of temporary steam to minimize impacts on the Biological Research Tower mission. Services will also include Hazardous Material verification and cost estimating services.

title: A/E Services for BRT Steam Vault Renewal
short_description: Engineering design and construction management for steam vault renewal at Ohio State University.
project_scope: Renewal of the BRT steam vault at Ohio State University, including initial site planning, project phasing options, performance requirements for vehicle and pedestrian circulation, analysis of temporary steam arrangements to minimize impacts on the Biological Research Tower mission, hazardous material verification, cost estimating, and construction management. Total construction cost stated as 2.6 million.
services: Full architect/engineer services including engineering, design, and construction management; programming; civil engineering; geotechnical engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; hazardous waste engineering; solid waste engineering; mechanical engineering; structural engineering; utility engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Utility/infrastructure renewal project focused on a steam vault, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Includes structural engineering, but the main scope is building utility and site coordination.
- Strong emphasis on mechanical, hazardous materials, and construction management reduces fit with sbp core profile.
- Small construction budget indicates limited structural ambition or complexity.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the tender documents.
